title: Nonstabilizerness of the entangling layer in quantum circuit Born machines
summary: The entangling layer of a quantum circuit Born machine can supply both entanglement and nonstabilizerness. In this work we show that the entangling layer can be a Clifford circuit, which supplies no nonstabilizerness. We use an architecture in which a fixed, non-trainable entangler is reused in every layer and only single-qubit rotations are optimized.
